## Cross Sell Opportunities

Enhance your mobile app ecosystem with complementary AVENIQ services:

- **UI/UX Design**: Pair mobile engineering with specialized mobile interface design, gesture prototyping, and user testing.
- **API Integration**: Connect your mobile app backend with enterprise CRMs, inventory databases, and third-party payment engines.
- **Cloud Deployment**: Host your mobile app API infrastructure on high-availability containerized cloud servers.
- **Maintenance & Support**: Protect your app store presence with ongoing iOS/Android OS compatibility updates and SLA support.
